files.purpose: Services-layer extension on the Core model MCPCatalogEntry that adds resolve(values:), turning a catalog entry plus the user's stored field values into the launchable MCPResolvedServer (id and name copied from the entry). For .stdio it keeps the command verbatim, fills every {key} placeholder in args and env via the Core fill(_:values:) helper and drops env variables whose filled value is empty; for .http it fills the URL and headers and drops empty headers; for .oauth it points url at the app's local proxy route MCPProxy.url(for: id) and keeps the filled real address in oauthUpstream. The doc comment states it is 'Kept out of Core because it needs the proxy' - the file exists only to restore the Core-depends-on-nothing layer rule.
key_symbols: nested func fill(_ text: String) -> String { self.fill(text, values: values) }
case .stdio(let command, let args): server.command / server.args = args.map(fill) / server.env = env.mapValues(fill).filter { !$0.value.isEmpty }
case .http(let url, let headers): server.url = fill(url) / server.headers = headers.mapValues(fill).filter { !$0.value.isEmpty }
case .oauth(let url): server.url = MCPProxy.url(for: id) / server.oauthUpstream = fill(url)
calls_into: Called by MCPStore.enabledServers (MCPStore.swift:46) and MCPStore probe path (MCPStore.swift:313), both B3
side_effects: None directly; the pure mapping reads MCPProxy.port through MCPProxy.url(for:) for OAuth entries (port loading/picking is MCPProxy's concern).
platform_assumptions: None beyond Foundation; the proxy URL is loopback 127.0.0.1 built by MCPProxy.
